problems.problem: The lime swoosh-echo disc (ellipse bbox x850-1060, y870-1060) is still majority-occluded by the toe: only a right-side crescent (roughly x940-1060) emerges past the white toe bumper, so the brief's 'lime disc echoing the swoosh at the toe' reads as a green blob clipped by the product instead of a composed printed mark framing the toe. Shift the disc so clear disc geometry surrounds the toe tip (e.g. center further right/up) while staying inside the canvas.

A dead lemon void of roughly 420px (title/logo block ends y263, shoe collar starts y599) separates the Bodoni plate from the product zone; the thin navy rule at y760-774 now stops in margin at both ends but still floats inside that void touching nothing, so headline, rule and lane band never share a grid line and the type block feels pasted above the product. Either lift the product zone or pull the rule/lane into one aligned grid so the upper third connects to the silhouette.

Hierarchy stays top-loaded: the band bottom (y1190) to canvas bottom (y1440, ~17% of height) is empty lemon paper with no closing element, while the 46px 'Nike' logo and the lime decoration rule sit isolated under the title. References 3-4 close their compositions with type or a mark near the product zone; here the lower margin reads as unfinished space rather than intentional negative space.

The lane band (x60-1020, y960-1190) now correctly insets both ends and covers heel and forefoot, but its top edge y960 cuts the white sole mid-height at the heel while the forefoot lugs dip to y1109, leaving a tall navy slab (y1109-1190, ~80px) below the contact line that visually outweighs the shoe; the printed lane reads as a plinth block rather than a track lane the silhouette rides.
